name: Chandler
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Chandler for 2026, and here is what he found: 19 family events, 15 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (40th Anniversary of The Nutcracker) through January 3, 2027 (the Tumbleweed Tree stays lit nightly), with the Tumbleweed Tree Lighting and Parade of Lights (December 5), Polar Express at Tumbleweed Recreation Center (December 9 to 11) and Santa's House (December 12, 15 and 19) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Chandler

  • 19 Christmas events for kids in Chandler
  • 15 free events, including the Tumbleweed Tree Lighting and Parade of Lights, Santa's House and the C-Town Snow Day at Chandler Museum
  • Meet Santa: Santa's House at Dr. A.J. Chandler Park, Santa at Chandler Fashion Center and Cookies and Crafts with Mrs. Claus
  • Parades and tree lightings: Tumbleweed Tree Lighting and Parade of Lights (December 5)
  • Trains: Polar Express train ride at Tumbleweed Recreation Center (December 9 to 11, registration required)
  • Season: November 27 to January 3, 2027

Planning a bigger day out? Chandler families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Phoenix, which covers ZooLights at the Phoenix Zoo, Las Noches de las Luminarias at the Desert Botanical Garden and the APS Electric Light Parade.
